title: Micron warns RAM shortage will worsen through 2028 as it celebrates record profits
summary: Micron forecasts greater shortage and higher RAM prices in coming years due to AI demand.

title: OpenAI dismantles reasoning extraction campaign linked to Chinese Moonshot AI

summary: The new Gears of War stands out for its intensive CPU usage in Unreal Engine 5 and launches a line of themed keyboards and mice.

summary: Gemini 4 Argon expands its context window to one million tokens and strengthens coding and security capabilities.

summary: HP's new laptop features Intel Wildcat Lake, OLED display, and promises exceptional battery life to compete with Apple.

summary: Leaks reveal the 28-core Core Ultra 9 4970K BFC and integration of USB4 80Gbps and PCIe 5.0 on the Nova Lake platform.

summary: The new Kindles eliminate the raised bezel, reduce weight and size, and adopt removable batteries to comply with European law.
